tasks.objective: Wire the overseer dispatch FSM so it actually RUNS the reachability gate at the WIRE_UP phase: add a 'wired' label branch to make_default_gate_runner._run_gate that calls overseer.gates.wired on the recorded wire report.

spec.objective: Wire the overseer dispatch FSM so it actually RUNS the reachability gate at the WIRE_UP phase: add a 'wired' label branch to make_default_gate_runner._run_gate that calls overseer.gates.wired on the recorded wire report.
functional_requirements: Import wired from overseer.gates (add it to the existing 'from overseer.gates import ...' statement alongside the other gate functions).
In make_default_gate_runner's inner _run_gate(label, arts, attested, sd), add a branch for label == 'wired' (a BACKED gate, placed near the existing 'verified' branch).

The 'wired' branch reads the wire report from arts.get('wire_report'); when it is None (no report recorded), return _missing('wire report', <actionable hint>) so it fails closed, never silent-pass; otherwise return wired(report).

Leave gate_label_for and every existing label branch (oracle_is_red, oracle_committed, brief_written, plan_ready, verified, posture_ok, preflight_clean/swept, registry_zeroed, pushed, attested labels) unchanged.
spec.interfaces: make_default_gate_runner(repo_root, state_dir, *, run_seam=None, git_seam=None, status_seam=None, pending_seam=None, pushed_seam=None) -> gate_runner(mode, phase, rec, state_dir_arg=None) -> GateResult, now resolving the WIRE_UP phase ('wired' label) by calling overseer.gates.wired(arts['wire_report']). wired(report) -> GateResult is the existing function in overseer.gates.
edge_cases: arts has no 'wire_report' key -> _missing(...) GateResult(ok=False) with a non-empty fix_hint (fail closed).
non_goals: No change to overseer.gates.wired itself, to the procedure registry, to turn_runner, or to the orchestrator accept path.
Do NOT compute check_wired here or populate wire_report -- this leaf only dispatches an already-recorded report (runtime population is a separate concern).
No new agent/process/network call. Preserve all existing gate_runner behaviour and tests.
This is an integration edit to an existing module.

integration_tests: drives the live public gate_runner end-to-end (committed oracle)
